notes.title: Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero - Major Update: Breaking the Silence!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="xJklrHq30qw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i][u](Due to Steam's 5 MB file limit, the quality of our GIFs has been reduced. For high-resolution graphics, you can watch our YouTube video.)[/u][/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/4feaca7ce606055f619ee156933b34b01d43f63c.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear Eternity’s Echo Community,[/p][p]After months of deep silence, we are finally here. That silence had a purpose: we were working on an update that not only improves Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero but completely reimagines it, reshaping every part to deliver the dark, ruthless, and immersive experience we envisioned.[/p][p]That day is today.[/p][p]These update notes are not just a list of changes but a manifesto of our dedication, passion, and the effort we have poured into every detail of the game’s DNA. Without skipping a single detail, here are the revolutionary innovations:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/429de9ecb0a2fb1d71a772662e40f41419701170.png"][/img][/p][h1]I. MECHANICS: THE EVOLUTION OF GAMEPLAY[/h1][p]We unified the core mechanics of the game into a living, interconnected system. Every feature now influences and triggers another.[/p][h2]Core System Integration & Bug Fixing [/h2][p]The backbone of this update is the seamless integration of all existing systems. Every mechanic added since the demo now communicates and interacts with one another. Your actions will create interconnected consequences. We have also resolved all potential issues within this massive system network to deliver a more stable and fluid gameplay experience.[/p][h2]Perspective Revolution: Fully FPS Interaction [/h2][p]We have overhauled the basic interaction system to draw you deeper into the world. Inspecting objects and adding items to your inventory is now done entirely from a first-person (FPS) perspective rather than third-person (TPS). This allows you to feel every detail more closely. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/46e66a89f72d00264e3e14622b37c81b8288ee76.gif"][/img]As part of this change, equipment like the flashlight has been moved from the weapon to the character’s head for better realism and usability.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/55fb048ac3f8bdfd3b0fdccfe32e7b351b69b4f9.gif"][/img][/p][h2]New Mechanic: Ultra-Detailed Tactical Magazine Management [/h2][p]Reloading is now a strategic decision.[/p][p]● [b]Your Choice:[/b] A new menu option lets you pick your playstyle. You can reload quickly and sacrifice the bullets left in the mag, or take your time and save the remaining rounds. In times of scarcity, this could mean the difference between life and death.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/7a79a0306b768c2e8d56827ab5530abcc811cee7.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]● Manual Ammo Check:[/b] By holding “R,” you can now remove your magazine and check the remaining rounds in real time. No more surprises.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/8f09fd8ca387ca60cf681b58ef8163daa8856f46.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]● Animation Depth:[/b] Dozens of new, detailed reload animations depending on whether your weapon is empty, half-full, or nearly full.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/8fc84184c07bae98efeeca4e3ac118f20406dc63.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/6c68b92d95ed5b48be0c6bf8ad5706251e2b8d0f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/e476140ed63a6577530dc58a47ce95e929b9c935.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][b]New Mechanic:[/b] The Rise of the Techblade & Advanced Mods Your throwable and recallable blade, the Techblade, has grown deadlier.[/p][p][b]● Electric Mode Activated:[/b] The new electric mode is fully functional, complete with striking visual effects. It can temporarily stun AIs, electrify water surfaces, and play a crucial role in environmental puzzles.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/c575d6547f7e674453ab8d57e4e4e9b340501b48.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]● Time-Based Strategy:[/b] Mods are no longer infinite. You must carefully plan which mode to use and when.[/p][p][b]● Instant Switching:[/b] A new menu system allows quick switching between mods to adapt to the flow of combat instantly.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/195b2b8bcd1d534c6fd0174db80f8bd625d77afd.gif"][/img][/p][h2]New Mechanic: Advanced Healthwatch & Data Screens [/h2][p]Your watch has evolved into a survival hub. Beyond tracking health and heartbeat, it now includes expanded screens offering much more data and functionality, becoming a control center tailored to your needs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/4ec678a2aa6c8fdfceef7d33635765382cb04825.gif"][/img][/p][h2]New Mechanic: Push Your Limits with Dash & Slide [/h2][p]Your character now has new acrobatic abilities that make you unstoppable.[/p][p][b]● Dash:[/b] Evade bullets, change cover, or slip behind enemies with a burst of speed. Those critical seconds may save you.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/47e340b25c61ce2d993e71b29c397499efe72aa7.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]● Slide:[/b] Maintain momentum and dodge enemy fire by sliding under obstacles.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/82c8c83e9f0423d652af9e0e2cb44147c11e44b7.gif"][/img][/p][h2]New Mechanic: Fighting Desperation: Healing & Dynamic Cover[/h2][p][b]● Self-Healing:[/b] You can now recover health at critical moments using special collectible equipment found in the environment.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/29d8113da472962d5254eb86d5793bbbb11d433d.gif"][/img]  [/p][p]  [/p][p][b]● Dynamic Barricades:[/b] Are you caught in the middle of a fight? Interact with nearby objects like tables or cabinets to knock them over and create instant cover in combat.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/bf675a95762bd22c390b58d2942617dff5667940.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Other Vital Mechanic Improvements[/h2][p][b]● Leaning Left & Right:[/b] Peek and shoot from cover safely with an improved lean system.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/ed791079403829c6e7fc5c0f1eddbded128a9b45.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]● Layered Health Feedback:[/b] Health is no longer just a number. Visual and audio cues intensify danger based on the severity of damage.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/001ea5123c3708f2da9ee682b447ea6ae06709b8.png"][/img]  [/p][p][b]● Alternative Ways:[/b] Locked doors are no longer the end. A new system gives you layered options for entering. (More details on this soon!)[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/f6c6557904cf9750de174b2a5f995aba161d37ac.gif"][/img][/p][p]Realistic, destructible glass adds cinematic impact to combat[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/d77dec014b5d67f3c3f32f4900b246356d9fe97d.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][b]● Information-Based Puzzle System:[/b] A new puzzle mechanic tests your observation skills by requiring you to gather environmental clues.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/aab7f924cb5fbaadbee1c504902c1a29178c5b28.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/c215ca4e9154beee862594df8675d5cae80c2d58.png"][/img][/carousel][p][b]● New Menus & Full Control:[/b] We redesigned both main and pause menus. Custom keybinding gives players complete freedom to play their way.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/64bd94d28b26f0ed13e5ed9d1837c2b021e464b9.png"][/img][/p][h1]II. HUMAN AI: SMART, RUTHLESS & REALISTIC[/h1][p]Enemies are no longer scripted puppets. They think, react, and hunt you.[/p][h2]Advanced Behavior Trees & Tactical Intelligence [/h2][p]Tested across countless scenarios, enemies now feature:[/p][p][b]● Situational Awareness:[/b] Enemies drop whatever they are doing (patrolling, repairing, etc.) if they see you. They react to nearby gunfire and return to their duties if you’re out of range.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/3c17b627472cb2def867a9396aa9ce97529a9f5b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]● Smarter Sound Detection:[/b] They no longer rush blindly toward noise. Instead, they approach cautiously, scanning the area.  [/p][p][b]● Cover Logic:[/b] Enemies won’t fire at you through solid objects like walls, but will shoot through glass.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/80f215468b10b03c291f932c6b493ba7db5c4041.gif"][/img][/p][h2]A Living World: AI Routines[/h2][p]Enemies now feel part of a living world, with routines like:[/p][p]● Patrolling specific routes[/p][p]● Standing guard between two points[/p][p]● Stopping for conversations[/p][p]● Wandering randomly while mumbling[/p][p]● Doing single tasks (cleaning, repairing, etc.) until combat breaks out[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/8f712c814b6600d584dfdaa41823dea1207ae4c5.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/40de25e08f2205ece15cd78412faa6e2c17e357b.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/50f6bc758533a19bc88968598d92100babe26b25.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/60b3db767ec093d028465bb7e1c490978d01380e.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/057181598e20b7215993138824451c5e568abe98.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/4fe1b4eaf08ec7c22ae9fd5a5941a7278af5f62a.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/7c012a32d62c2ae66d7935a3e9f04c82d2d8824c.gif"][/img][/carousel][h2]Reactive Dialogue System: Listen to Them! [/h2][p]Enemies now talk, reflecting their state and environment:[/p][p]● Express pain or anger when hit[/p][p]● Reacting not only to footsteps or gunfire but also to your UV light, flashlight, and even the sound of your thrown Techblade.[/p][p]● Display shock at discovering bodies or anger when comrades die mid-combat.[/p][p]● Engaging in situational chatter during patrols, work, and reloads[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/ba307d9965d217bcb2ef9e1f05a72fd3a0560b6b.png"][/img][/p][h2]Location-Based Damage: Every Bullet Matters [/h2][p]Every bullet counts. Enemies play specific animations based on hit location and collapse realistically with ragdoll physics. Shoot their weapon arm, and they’ll drop their gun in panic, switching to a sidearm.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/7a83ada496e97c0aa2228d453e6552ed3bfafb6d.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/acc1295c231e2ee538ca7b5492b0056aae693da9.gif"][/img][/carousel][h1]III. CREATURE AI: NIGHTMARE OF THE DV’s[/h1][p]Dimensional Visitors (DVs) are now wilder, smarter, and terrifying.[/p][h2]Predator Instincts: Sight & Sound[/h2][p]They rely primarily on sound and secondarily on limited sight. It may be possible to sneak past them, but even a small noise can trigger a swarm.[/p][h2]Unpredictable Behavior Trees[/h2][p][b]● Exploration Mode:[/b] Follow set patrol routes or roam randomly in search of prey.[/p][p][b]● Hunting Mode:[/b] When hearing a sound, they pause, scan the area, then sprint toward the source. If they don’t see you, they sniff around for a while. Once they do see you, relentless pursuit begins.[/p][p][b]● Group Attacks:[/b] With enough DVs, they try to surround and cut off escape routes, moving smartly without colliding. Obstacles like falls won’t stop them; they’ll get up and continue the chase.[/p][h2]Wild Reactions: Physics-Based Damage [/h2][p]Every bullet impacts them realistically. In this entirely physics-based system, they stagger, stumble, or collapse depending on where the bullet hits them.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/1a2e6c7a1b03b17c05af040b06f3bce5ffcc2066.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/116c05554df4afc21400e850f91b849ade6b7bcc.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/4a2d5bf06a9477412da97eea786f8f38c77a643f.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2]Collective Intelligence: Environmental Query System (EQS) [/h2][p]They’re no longer just mindless monsters. Through EQS, they constantly query their environment to find optimal attack positions. This lets them coordinate, avoid collisions, and attack from multiple angles effectively.[/p][p][/p][p]This update represents our vision and commitment to Eternity’s Echo: Patient Zero. We can’t wait for you to dive back in and experience these new features. Your feedback will continue to guide us as we shape this dark world.[/p][p]Welcome back to hell. This time, you’d better be ready.[/p][p]Sincerely, [/p][p][b]The Eternity’s Echo Development Team[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/1013256297b7d004f1812538196e729b351987dd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DEMO HAS BEEN REMOVED
notes.notes: [p]The demo for Eternity’s Echo: Patient Zero is no longer available.[/p][p]We’re incredibly grateful for all the support and feedback you’ve shared during this phase. Every insight we gathered is now being used to refine and expand the full experience.[/p][p]We’ll be back with the full story, new content and a deeper, more immersive journey.[/p][p]Stay tuned.[/p]

notes.title: Last day of demo and 2nd Trailer Release - May 25th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/a05c1a72fc7588076fd47f2c3476dc1c2773879c.png[/img]
[b]Hello Everyone,
[/b]
We're taking down the first demo of Eternity's Echo on May 25th. This demo represented an important step in our development process and your feedback helped us shape the future of the game. Thank you to everyone who participated.
[h3]Why are we taking it down?
[/h3]The demo was released to introduce the early systems and atmosphere. From there, we want to move forward with new locations, mechanics and content. For a more consistent, stable and comprehensive gameplay experience, we're moving towards a full release.
[h3]What will happen on May 25th?
[/h3]Demo access will be removed.
The demo will no longer be available to download and play on Steam.
Second trailer will be released.
The trailer, which includes new scenes, new story details and sections that reflect the atmosphere more clearly, will be available to watch on social media and YouTube on May 25th.
[h3]What's in the Trailer?
[/h3]The new trailer will go beyond the first trailer and give you a closer look at the game's theme, characters and locations.
We will also share information about the game's release schedule and the new roadmap in development in our post-trailer announcements.
[h3]Thank you all so much!
[/h3]The comments, suggestions and messages of support since the demo's release have been invaluable. You played an active role in making the game better.
Eternity's Echo is a game not only for the developers but also for this community,

[h3]Stay tuned
[/h3]

notes.title: Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero - Ten Thousand Eighth Minute Update Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]We Added Mouse Sensitivity Adjustment:[/b] Players can now adjust mouse sensitivity.
[*] [b]Invert Y-Axis Option:[/b] Inverted axis control is now available.
[*] [b]Added UI for pre-DV Battle:[/b] We've added a new UI to help before Dimensional Variant (DV) battles.
[*] [b]Added 2K and 4K Resolution Support: [/b]You can now play the game in higher resolutions.
[*] [b]Updated the Main Menu Intro sentence:[/b] We changed the dialog that appears when there are no saves.
[*] [b]Updated Lantern On/Off Mechanics:[/b] We've made using the flashlight in the Interact system more convenient.
[*] [b]Added Rayne's Death Dialogs: [/b]We've added 20 new post-death dialogs, which will give you a different new approach each time you die and give you tips on how to progress through the market.
[*] [b]Adjusted DV Spawn Times:[/b] We made minor balance updates to enemy spawn times.
[*] Incorporated the Last Bike in the Trunk Flyer into the Laplace System: We added a new detail in the context of the story.
[*] [b]Added two new Easter Eggs:[/b] We've added two new surprises for you to discover.
[*] [b]We Updated the Garage Closing Sound: [/b]We added a more realistic sound effect.
[*] Bug Fixes
[*] [b]We Fixed Skyrim Giant Bug:[/b] The hanging man will no longer pop up abnormally when you pause the game.
[*] [b]Fixed Menu Subtitle Bug:[/b] We fixed an issue with subtitles in the menu.
[*] [b]Localization Updates: [/b]Fixed various language bugs.
[*] [b]Updated the Game Launch Icon: [/b]We added a new and more responsive icon.
[*] [b]We Added Stopper UI for Flashlight Use: [/b]We've added an additional, more intuitive notification UI for using the flashlight.
[/list]

With this update, we made both gameplay improvements and technical fixes. Your feedback is very important to us, don't forget to share your comments!

Demonsoft Games Team

notes.title: Dive into the Shadows: "Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero" Livestream Replay
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We’re breaking the silence and getting ready to step into the depths of darkness with "Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero"

We will be replaying our NextFest livestream tonight for 1 week On February 26th evening, gather your courage to uncover forgotten secrets and the truths whispered by shadows. If you have missed the livestream you can watch it and try the NextFest demo!

[b][h3]CHECK "ETERNITY'S ECHO: PATIENT ZERO" DEMO ON STEAM!
[/h3][/b]
But that’s just the beginning...
Live Stream replay on February 26th evening!
Join us for a special event featuring exclusive guests from our development team, where we’ll delve into in-game footage, the making of the game, and more. Prepare to feel the mystery in your bones. Are you ready?

[b][h3]Don’t forget to:[/h3][/b]
Join our Discord server to stay updated on events.
https://discord.gg/TV8Xryf3UY
Follow us on social media for the latest news.
Wishlist the game to receive notifications and don’t miss out on this dark story.

[b][h3]What is "Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero"[/h3]
[/b]
Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero invites players to follow the journey of Rayne Williams as she chases forgotten truths and unravels dark secrets. With her past shrouded in mystery, Rayne must navigate abandoned places and whispering shadows, questioning both reality and her own mind. Every step pulls her deeper, and the answers might be closer than she thinks... but also more dangerous.

But beware; in this world, answers are only the beginning of bigger questions. Are you ready?

notes.title: Minute One Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We want to address an important issue with the demo for Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero. Due to an error on Valve's end during the Steam upload process, an outdated version of the game was mistakenly made available for Next Fest for 2 hours. . We sincerely apologize for the confusion and inconvenience this caused.

The good news is that the updated and correct version of the Next Fest demo is now live! 🎉 This update includes all the latest fixes, features, and improvements we’ve been working on to deliver the best experience possible.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we worked with Valve to resolve this issue. Your feedback is invaluable, so please let us know your thoughts on the updated demo!

Thank you for being part of the journey with Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero. We can’t wait to hear what you think.

Stay tuned for more updates, and see you in the game!

The Demonsoft Games & Blackburne Games

notes.title: Summary of Progress: Developer Log from V19.5
notes.notes:
We are excited to share the latest updates for Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero. Here are the significant technical improvements and innovations in version 19.5:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/37dd00e13d9216e1d9bf42fe953604d2bb03d57b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/aad24d5ca1e3aeab9be56eb2bec744c99e63cf93.png[/img]
[h3][b]Techblade Energy Level Display[/b] [/h3]
We have made an improvement to display the energy level of our Techblade on the watch on our left wrist. Now, as the energy level fills up, three boxes on the edge of the watch fill in, allowing players to easily track their energy levels. This new feature serves as a visual feedback mechanism that enables players to better plan their combat strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/fa204d7ee21af0c6024dc9725659c5d7ace53b2b.png[/img]
[h3][b]Motel Level Progress[/b]
[/h3]
We have made significant progress in the Motel level. By enhancing the environmental details and playability of this area, we aim to provide a more immersive experience. The new textures, lighting effects, and interactive objects in the Motel level offer players a richer atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/4d6c45e79cea7f32839d65d2c8978b360768d705.png[/img]
[h3][b]Forest Level Progress[/b]
[/h3]
Similarly, we have made substantial advancements in the Forest level. By working on environmental details and playability, we have made this area richer and more explorable. The dynamic weather conditions, sound effects, and flora and fauna diversity in the Forest level provide players with a more realistic gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/e4b9e36fd8a8e0149c50838c9c88181457da03da.png[/img]
[h3][b]Enemy AI Improvements[/b]
[/h3]
Improvements have been made to the animations of enemy AI. We have undertaken detailed work to make the movements of AI more fluid and realistic. By updating the movement algorithms of enemy characters, we have ensured they exhibit smarter and more unpredictable behaviors.

Additionally, special work has been done on enemy AI breaking through locked doors. This allows enemies to overcome obstacles in front of players, offering a more dynamic and challenging experience. This new feature adds a game mechanic that requires players to be on alert at all times, increasing the game's tension.

We are happy to push our game further with these updates. Thank you for your continued support and stay tuned for more updates!


Best regards, 
[u][b]The Demonsoft Games Team[/b][/u]

notes.title: Summary of Progress: Developer Log from V19

[list]
[*] Implemented an ID card system along with authorization mechanics to control access and add depth to the storyline. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757968/2d9fd1225282ed4ff3a762f7220134511b25d998.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Playable Areas[/b] 
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Created new playable areas, expanding the world of Eternity's Echo and offering more exploration opportunities. 
[/list]
[h3][b]Main Menu Enhancements[/b] 
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the main menu for better navigation and a more polished user experience. 
[/list]
[h3][b]Artificial Intelligence (AI) Improvements[/b] 
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Developed sophisticated AI behaviors, sensitivity, and dominance settings. 
[*] Created environments with proxy links for dynamic transitions. 
[*] Defined AI states and linked them to the Environmental Query System (EQS) for real-time decision-making. For instance, if an AI encounters a door while running, it will either break through if locked or pass through if open. 
[*] Integrated AI states with animation blueprints, ensuring the correct animations play based on the AI's current state. 
[*] Activated physical interactions, allowing AI movements to be based on realistic physics. 
[/list]
We hope these updates bring you as much excitement as they did for us in development. 
Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for more updates! 

Best regards, 
[u][b]The Demonsoft Games Team[/b][/u]

notes.title: Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero - Our First Official Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Dear Players[/b]
The Demonsoft Games team is thrilled to finally share our first official announcement about the development of Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero! We've been quiet until now, but we're excited to let you know that we'll be communicating with you more frequently from this point forward.

[b]Progress in Game Development[/b]
We've been working with great care and passion on Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero, and we've made significant progress so far. We're advancing steadily towards our goals, focusing intensely on the game world, story, gameplay mechanics, and graphics. Our team has meticulously crafted the core elements of the game, and we're pleased with how everything is coming together.

[b]More Frequent Communication with the Community[/b]
Starting today, we'll be sharing updates about the game's development with you more frequently. Every week or two, we'll provide new updates and content to keep you informed about our progress. These updates will include details on different aspects of the game, gameplay videos, character introductions, and more.

[b]Your Feedback Matters[/b]
Your support and feedback are incredibly valuable to us. We'll be working to make our game even better based on your thoughts and suggestions. So please don't hesitate to share your ideas with us. Your feedback will guide us as we continue to develop the game.

[b]Upcoming Updates[/b]
In the coming days, we'll share more content and detailed information about the game's development process. In our initial updates, we'll provide more insights into the story, characters, and gameplay mechanics. Stay tuned and don't miss out on the latest developments in the creation of [b]Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero![/b]

Thank you for joining us on this exciting journey. We can't wait to bring you the best gaming experience possible and share this process with you.

[b]The Demonsoft Games Team[/b]
